title: Adam and Eve in the Garden of Eden
description: God forms man from dust, places him in the Garden of Eden to work and keep it, forbids him to eat from the tree of knowledge, and creates woman from his rib as a helper suitable for him.

versions.title: Adam and Eve in the Garden of Eden
versions.description: God places man in the Garden of Eden to work and keep it, forbids him to eat from the tree of knowledge, and creates Eve from his rib as a helper.
